blurb: Guests fly in a two-seat, open-cockpit powered glider with an FAA-certified instructor. Flights range from 20 minutes to 60 minutes, with opportunities to take the controls. Photos and video are included with the longest flight.
extraNote: Deposit required to book; amount specified before payment · Deposit 100% refundable up to 72 hours before flight · Deposit non-refundable if no show or cancellation less than 72 hours before flight · Reservations can be changed up to 5pm the day before; deposit transferable subject to availability · Weather dependent; flights may be delayed or rescheduled; deposit transferable or refundable if rescheduled · Dillingham Airfield, 45 minutes from Honolulu, with free onsite parking
